svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 1,200 x 700 mm from 12 mm exterior plywood, square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 16 countersunk 6.5 mm holes over the rivet nuts in the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: frame: drill through the deck into the nuts' centres with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Side rails: 15 mm in from each long edge, at 200, 600 and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1,000 mm from the front edge (these also hold the brackets).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: End rails: 15 mm in from the ends, 150 mm each side of centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Crossmembers at 300, 620 and 950 mm: 200 mm each side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seal every edge and hole with exterior sealer before fitting.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the loading zone: payload centre between 32 mm ahead

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 57 mm behind the deck centre (CGM-CAL-001).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lies flat on the frame with every hole over a nut.
